newsitem.title: GHANA: Ashanti Zimbabwe gold sale fixed at 125,600 oz.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti Zimbabwe gold sale fixed at 125,600 oz.

text.p: Ashanti Zimbabwe will deliver 125,600 ounces of gold under a $40 million seven-year prepaid forward gold sale agreement, Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd group treasurer Mona Caesar-Addo said.
The deal was signed earlier this month but the gold amount was fixed Thursday. Delivery will start in March 1998 and is underwritten by Ashanti Goldfields.

The agreement to refinance the former Cluff Resources operations in Zimbabwe, signed with Union Bank of Switzerland and Dresdner Bank AG Metals Group in New York, will allow the company to save more than $1 million a year in interest costs.
The funds will be used to refinance $28 million of high-coupon debt and make available $12 million to finance expansion of the Freda Rebecca mine near Harare.
